symptom: EACCES on port 5432 (Windows)
cause: the port sits in a Hyper-V/WSL excluded range
fix: pin another port (5770) in the db script, DATABASE_URL and the test config together
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build
command: netsh interface ipv4 show excludedportrange protocol=tcp

symptom: npm script written with single quotes breaks on cmd.exe
cause: cmd.exe passes single quotes raw
fix: use escaped double quotes in package.json scripts
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: spawn npm ENOENT from a tool that spawns without a shell
cause: on Windows PATH holds npm.cmd, not npm
fix: point the tool at a real executable (node node_modules/.../bin.js) or resolve with shutil.which
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

signature: Attempted to call \w+Variants\(\) from the server
symptom: buttonVariants() called from a server component
cause: the primitive file is 'use client' but holds no hooks
fix: drop 'use client' from the primitive file (it has no hooks)
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: Turbopack: Can't resolve './x.tsx.tsx'
cause: a turbopack rule with `as: '*.tsx'` renames modules and breaks 'use client' boundaries
fix: remove `as` from same-type loader rules (deckhand's stamp rule has none)
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

signature: Blocked cross-origin request to Next\.js dev resource
symptom: Next dev blocks HMR/dev resources through a proxy
cause: Origin/Host was 127.0.0.1 (not in allowedDevOrigins)
fix: proxy rewrites Host/Origin to localhost (tryon serve does this)
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

signature: hostname \"[^\"]+\" is not configured under images
symptom: next/image: remote demo image host not configured
cause: a registry block uses a remote stock photo
fix: staged <Image> gets `unoptimized`; demo photos are replaced by /deckhand-placeholder.svg
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: TypeScript 7 has no JS compiler API
cause: typescript@7 is native (Go) and exports only its version
fix: deckhand parses with vendored @babel/parser — never the project's typescript
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: upstream SVGProps without type argument
cause: React 19 types require SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>
fix: materialize compat pass adds the type argument
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: tailark.com registry blocks answer 401
cause: paid tier endpoint
fix: use the MIT OSS source (tailark/blocks on GitHub, oss-tailark.com)
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: cult-ui registry answers 429 (bot challenge)
cause: Vercel bot protection on the registry host
fix: excluded from the catalog; do not retry

symptom: Next warns Unrecognized key 'turbo'
cause: Next >= 15.3 reads turbopack.rules, older reads experimental.turbo
fix: the next-plugin picks the right home from next's version

symptom: Coolify dashboard reachable from the internet
cause: Docker-published ports bypass the host firewall
fix: loopback-bind Coolify's ports in its compose + SSH tunnel (references/ops/10-bootstrap-vps.md §3b)
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: a stale deployment looked like success
cause: the newest finished deployment was for an older commit
fix: wait with --expect-commit <sha> (dh deploy ship does)
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: ssh: Host key verification failed in an unattended run
cause: the known_hosts used by the scheduler differs from yours
fix: store the host key at first contact in the durable known-hosts path (references/ops/10-bootstrap-vps.md)
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: a schedule that was never verified
cause: manual runs prove the script, not the schedule
fix: fire it once through its own trigger (gh workflow run / systemctl start / schtasks /Run) before calling it live
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: Prisma P1001 can't reach the database in Coolify
cause: DATABASE_URL points at localhost instead of the internal service name
fix: use the Coolify internal URL of the database (postgres://…@<db-uuid>:5432/…)
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: auth secret missing at build/start
cause: local secrets were not generated for the environment
fix: generate a local secret per environment (dh clone does for .env; set it in Coolify env for prod)
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile fails
cause: lockfile out of date with package.json
fix: run pnpm install locally, commit the lockfile, then deploy
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

signature: Dynamic server usage|couldn't be rendered statically because it used `cookies`
symptom: next build: Dynamic server usage error
cause: a static page reads cookies/headers
fix: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' on that route, or move the read into a server action
source: deckhand v1 live runs + v2 build

symptom: next start (standalone) binds the machine name, or fails to bind, on Windows git-bash
cause: git-bash exports HOSTNAME=<machine name>; Next's standalone server listens on process.env.HOSTNAME
fix: start it with HOSTNAME=127.0.0.1 (Deckhand sets it for the servers it starts)
source: a Hermes field run, 2026-09-25 (Windows, git-bash)

symptom: EBUSY on .next/standalone while building or cleaning
cause: a persistent shell (or a server) has its working directory inside .next/standalone
fix: cd back to the project root in every shell, stop servers started from inside .next, then rebuild
source: a Hermes field run, 2026-09-25 (Windows, git-bash)

signature: listen EACCES: permission denied .*:\d+|EACCES.*0\.0\.0\.0:\d+|An attempt was made to access a socket in a way forbidden
symptom: EACCES when a server listens on a port nothing uses (Windows)
cause: the port is inside a range Windows reserves for Hyper-V/WSL/Docker
fix: pick a port outside `netsh interface ipv4 show excludedportrange protocol=tcp` (Deckhand picks bind-tested ports that skip them)
source: a Hermes field run, 2026-09-25 (Windows, git-bash)
command: netsh interface ipv4 show excludedportrange protocol=tcp

signature: (too many clients|remaining connection slots|Connection terminated unexpectedly|sorry, too many).*|pglite.*(connection|busy)
symptom: HTTP 500s under load with a local PGlite database
cause: PGlite serves one connection; a pg pool of 10 overruns it
fix: in dev with PGlite set the pool max to 1 (max: 1 or ?connection_limit=1); declare it with `dh dev add` so dev start/stop handle it
source: a Hermes field run, 2026-09-25 (Windows, git-bash)

signature: (ENOENT|No such file or directory|cannot find the path).*[/\\]tmp[/\\]
symptom: a file written to /tmp is missing for node/python/curl on Windows
cause: git-bash maps /tmp to its own folder; native tools see a different path
fix: write scratch files under the project (.deckhand/work/tmp/) and pass D:/… paths to native tools
source: a Hermes field run, 2026-09-25 (Windows, git-bash)

symptom: python/node cannot open a /d/… path given from git-bash
cause: native executables do not translate MSYS paths (/d/x); only bash builtins do
fix: pass D:/x (drive letter, forward slashes) to python, node and curl
source: a Hermes field run, 2026-09-25 (Windows, git-bash)
